description: This source file contains utility functions and logic for parsing, classifying, and managing test project configurations and runtimes within a testing framework using Vitest. It handles target classification, test plan creation, argument building, and file path management for running tests in a project.

methods.name: normalizePathPattern
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a path string for normalization.

methods.name: isExistingPathTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: isExistingFileTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: isGlobTarget
methods.description: Determines if a string matches glob pattern characters, indicating a pattern match.

methods.name: isFileLikeTarget
methods.description: Checks if a filename is a test file based on its extension pattern.

methods.name: isPathLikeTargetArg
methods.description: Determines if an argument refers to a valid path, including glob patterns and test files.

methods.name: toRepoRelativeTarget
methods.description: Converts a path argument to a path relative to the repository root, normalizing slashes.

methods.name: toScopedIncludePattern
methods.description: Creates a glob pattern for including test files based on a target argument.

methods.name: classifyTarget
methods.description: Classifies a target argument into categories like extension, channel, boundary, or default based on its path pattern and internal logic.

methods.name: createVitestArgs
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for executing Vitest with specified configs and options.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to separate forwarded args, target test files, and options like watch mode.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Creates a sequence of test run plans based on input arguments and classification, grouping targets by category and associating configs.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Generates detailed specifications for each test run, including environment setup and include file paths.

methods.name: writeVitestIncludeFile
methods.description: Writes the include patterns to a temporary JSON file for Vitest to read.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Builds the final argument array for executing Vitest based on parsed plans and command line inputs.
